gold_answer:
# Introduction

---

## Event Telemetry Report

The simulation engine has triggered a real-time event notification based on an environmental boundary wall collision interface.

---

## Real-Time Sandbox Overlay Feed

### WHAT HAPPENED
A moving body collided with the solid vertical containment border, triggering a reflection event (`bounce`).

### WHAT CHANGED
The horizontal component of the velocity vector reversed direction instantly, causing the object to rebound back toward the center.

### SIMPLE WHY
The rigid boundary wall exerts an equal and opposite normal force that reverses the object's horizontal momentum.

### WHAT TO NOTICE
Notice how the velocity vector arrow flips direction instantly upon impact while maintaining its vertical component.

# Bounce Boundary Reflection — Runtime Overlay

---

## Sandbox Event Detected

```
EVENT_TYPE   : BOUNDARY_REFLECTION
SUBTYPE      : BOUNCE
TIMESTAMP    : runtime::now()
ORIGIN       : particle_system_core
```

---

## Physics Engine Response

When a particle hits a boundary wall, the velocity vector is reflected across the wall's normal.

---

### Reflection Formula

$$
\vec{v}' = \vec{v} - 2(\vec{v} \cdot \hat{n})\hat{n}
$$

---

### Velocity Component Flip

| Axis Hit | Component Flipped | Preserved |
|----------|-------------------|-----------|
| Left / Right Wall | $v_x \to -v_x$ | $v_y$ |
| Top / Bottom Wall | $v_y \to -v_y$ | $v_x$ |
| Corner | Both flipped | Neither |

---

### Energy Behavior

$$
e' = e \cdot C_r
$$

Where $C_r$ is the **coefficient of restitution**:

| $C_r$ Value | Behavior |
|-------------|----------|
| $C_r = 1.0$ | Perfect elastic bounce |
| $0 < C_r < 1$ | Energy loss per bounce |
| $C_r = 0$ | Particle sticks to wall |

---

### Runtime State Patch

```js
onBoundaryHit(particle, wall) {
  const normal = wall.getNormal();
  const dot    = particle.vel.dot(normal);

  // Reflect velocity
  particle.vel = particle.vel
    .sub(normal.scale(2 * dot));

  // Apply restitution
  particle.vel = particle.vel
    .scale(wall.restitution);

  // Clamp position inside bounds
  particle.pos = clampToBounds(
    particle.pos, wall
  );

  emitEvent('BOUNCE', {
    particle : particle.id,
    wall     : wall.id,
    normal   : normal,
    energy   : particle.kineticEnergy()
  });
}
```

---

### Overlay Status

```
[ ✓ ] Velocity reflected
[ ✓ ] Restitution applied
[ ✓ ] Position clamped
[ ✓ ] BOUNCE event emitted
[ ✓ ] Overlay render complete
```
